summary: Iteration 13: Tested 3 bug fixes (Bug 1: Keyboard listener, Bug 2: Who are you flow, Bug 3: Save/Load navigation). Bug 3 fully verified via Playwright E2E. Bug 1 verified by static code review. Bug 2 verified by static code review (drag-and-drop to QUESTION_CHOICE not testable via web Playwright).

bug1_keyboard_listener.details: Keyboard.addListener with keyboardWillShow/keyboardDidShow at lines 268-274 sets keyboardH state. DialogPanel uses marginBottom: ts==='NAME_INPUT' && keyboardH > 0 ? keyboardH : 0 (line 1186). Cannot test real keyboard in Expo web preview.

bug2_who_are_you_flow.details: selectWhoAreYou() shows D_WHO_INTRO → D_WHO_ASK → NAME_INPUT. confirmName() calls showDialog(dWhoConfirm(name), ...) to show 'Nice to meet you' dialog, then checkBothAnswered() returns to QUESTION_CHOICE if only one question answered. No hanging in code path. Full E2E test requires drag-and-drop to QUESTION_CHOICE which is not possible via web Playwright.
